title: 工業力学
subtitle: Engineering Mechanics
keywords: Composition and decomposition of force 2.Equilibrium of forces and moment of force 3.Center of gravity 4.Mass movement 5.Laws of motion
educationalGoal: Students will: (1)balance of powers. (2)learn Newton's laws of motion. Since mechanics is the basis of mechanical engineering, it is essential to understanding any courses focused on mechanical engineering. Students will therefore acquire knowledge on topics such as inertia that are necessary for the design of high-speed machines.
advice: This course covers the basics of the statics and dynamics of objects. We will cover the following topics: 1. 2. 3. 4. Linear and planar motion of mass points 5. Laws of motion Students will learn the method of analysis of the motion of mass points and rigid bodies by setting up and solving equations of motion through exercises based on the items listed above. Students are required to understand these concepts, tackle practice problems, and then cultivate the ability to apply their knowledge to practical problems. Students are also required to tackle exercises using schematic drawings, and then imagine the application of forces and moments and the subsequent motion of mass points and rigid bodies. Students are expected to pay attention to significant figures and units.
requiredKnowledge: It is important to try a lot of exercises. A good understanding of high school math and physics. Always use a scientific calculator in class. Students with poor attitudes may be asked to learn and may not be allowed to attend. Recommend to use office hours. In addition, the content of this class is indispensable for understanding of specialized subjects from the next year.

activityGoals.body: Be able to calculate the balance of the forces and moment.
Be able to find the center of gravity of an object.
Be able to establish the equation of motion of the mass point, and calculate the speed and position of the mass.
Be able to establish equations of motion for simple machine models.
Be able to solve the equation of motion by applying mathematics

achievementLevels.ideal: ①Forces can be resolved in any direction. The magnitude, direction, and action line of the resultant force acting on different action points of the object can be obtained. ②Complex balances with different points of application can be obtained separately for force and moment. ③The center of gravity can be determined for objects with complex shapes. ④Calculate the equation of motion for any motion of the mass and solve it. ⑤Explain the laws of motion and calculate inertial, centripetal, and centrifugal forces.
achievementLevels.standard: ①Forces can be resolved in X-Y direction. The magnitude, direction, and action line of the resultant force acting on different action points of the object can be obtained. ②Simple balances with different points of application can be obtained separately for force and moment. ③The center of gravity can be determined for objects with simple shapes. ④Calculate the equation of motion for single motion of the mass and solve it. ⑤Explain the laws of motion and calculate inertial, centripetal, and centrifugal forces.
